Noncontrast CT scan of the head
CT angiography of the head and neck
MRI brain with diffusion-weighted imaging if CT does not show an acute lesion
Lumbar puncture with cerebrospinal-fluid cell count, protein, glucose, oligoclonal bands, IgG index, infectious PCR/serology, and cytology/flow cytometry

CT scan of the chest, abdomen, and pelvis with contrast
Serum vitamin B1, vitamin E, copper, thyroid studies, and comprehensive metabolic/toxicology testing
served: nystagmus: direction and whether it changes with gaze
CSF oligoclonal bands and IgG index
